label: Tuning and temperament of a performance
text: AR.O.A1.3.1 Tuning and temperament of a performance. Twelve-tone equal temperament divides the octave into twelve equal frequency ratios of 2^(1/12). The ratio fact uses MA; that a named instrument was so tuned is here.

warrant.standard: Instrumental and documentary evidence converge on the making
warrant.defeaters: Sample or document not from the work
